If you're using Spotify Free on Android and Crossfade has stopped working across all playlists, the first thing I'd check is whether the feature is available on your current plan. Spotify's Crossfade availability can depend on your subscription, so check Settings → Playback to see whether the option is available.

If Crossfade is missing, that may explain why songs no longer overlap. You can also try clearing Spotify's cache, updating the app, and restarting your phone in case there's an additional playback issue.

One thing to keep in mind: Gapless playback and Crossfade aren't the same. Gapless playback removes pauses between tracks, while Crossfade overlaps the end of one song with the beginning of the next.
